_help: Linux/macOS version of winxmerge-files.windows.json. Mark 2 files for a 2-way compare or 3 files for a 3-way merge (base, left, right in list order), then pick this from the context menu. "cmd" is looked up on PATH; use an absolute path if Waydir is started without it. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
name: Compare in WinXMerge
